reason: I've never heard of this store, and I'm not putting a few hundred dollars on a fixture I can't see in person. The 10% off is nice, but I'd want to compare the total at a few other stores first.
objection: If I change my mind I pay return shipping on a big boxed fixture, and it has to be unused and in the original packaging. That could cost me a fortune, and I know nothing about this store.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, or a free return label on a fixture. Reviews from real buyers with photos would also help, along with a code better than 10% off.
